findings.evidence: "pytest collects only `test_*.py` or `*_test.py` by default, so `user_tests.py` is silently skipped": a default of a vendor tool, with no source URL or checked date and no live-read instruction.
findings.fix: Add the source and date, for example "([pytest python_files](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/reference.html#confval-python_files), checked <date>)". Or tell the agent to read the project's live `python_files` setting (pytest.ini, pyproject `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`) or run `pytest --collect-only -q`.

findings.evidence: "Celery task names default to `module.function`, so jobs already queued under the old name fail after deploy (Celery logs \"Received unregistered task\")": a vendor default and log message, with no source URL or checked date.
findings.fix: Cite the official page and the date, for example "([Celery Tasks, names](https://docs.celeryq.dev/en/stable/userguide/tasks.html#names), checked <date>)". Or tell the agent to check the project's explicit `name=` arguments and run `celery inspect registered` before rating the rename.

findings.evidence: "Spring derives the default bean name from the class name (`UserService` becomes `userService`)": a framework default, with no source URL or checked date. The NestJS and Angular claims in the same bullet do carry them.
findings.fix: Add the same citation format used for NestJS and Angular, for example "([Spring classpath scanning, naming autodetected components](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/core/beans/classpath-scanning.html), checked <date>)".
